task: Fix filters resetting after navigate-away-and-back on the Projects list and Analytics screens so applied filters persist, render in the controls and drive results, while cleared filters stay cleared (EPMCDME-16054).

key_reasoning.reason: Ticket AC are clear on outcome, but the Projects root cause was not found by static reading and needs browser reproduction; scope is ambiguous on whether Leaderboard tab filters, top-N selectors and Projects sort count as 'filters', and which Projects list screen is meant (only the user-management-gated admin list has filters).

Closest pattern is the existing URL + localStorage persistence in utils/filters (EPMCDME-12703, EPMCDME-15058), so the fix adapts an existing mechanism (base M). Bumped to L: AC enumerate variant cases (restore on both screens, control display, results match, clear not restored) and no existing test template covers unmount/remount or the debounce-cancel-on-unmount window; flushing the AnalyticsFilters debounce on unmount risks a URL replace() rewriting the next route's query; any change to the shared filters util has blast radius across all list pages.

useProjectsFilters + ProjectsManagementFull and useAnalyticsFilters + AnalyticsFilters (possibly LeaderboardTab), with the shared filters util as a possible touch point; two screens, one tier. Scored M, matching the bundled M calibration example (epmcdme-10203, 3 components / moderate file count).

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M to L: AC enumerate specific edge/variant cases (clear-not-restored, control display after remount) with no existing remount or debounce-window test template
